Interface DefinitionWatchRequest<T>

Type Parameters:
T - The bean type
public interface DefinitionWatchRequest<T>
A request to watch the bean definitions of a type, started with WatchableBeanContext.definitions(io.micronaut.core.type.Argument): it selects the definitions, and is completed by one of its terminal operations, which choose what is watched of them.
  • The definitions themselves: watch(BeanDefinitionWatcher) for whole batches, or onAdded(Consumer), onRemoved(Consumer) and onReplaced(Consumer) for one change at a time, completed by watch().
  • The beans of the definitions: instances().
  • The executable methods of the definitions that carry an annotation: methods(Class).
BeanWatch watch = context.definitions(Codec.class)
    .qualifier(Qualifiers.byName("json"))
    .onAdded(definition -> register(definition))
    .onRemoved(definition -> unregister(definition))
    .watch();

A batch is the unit of delivery: a watch receives the definitions selected as its first batch, then one batch per change, such as the definitions a development reload retires and adds at once, so a watcher that aggregates what it selects never sees a half-applied reload. The per-change handlers are called for each definition of a batch once the batch is applied, after the batch watcher if there is one.

An @EachProperty or @EachBean definition is selected as the context resolves it: one definition per entry of its configuration, or per bean it is created for, in every batch.

Each terminal operation takes a snapshot of the request, so a request may be reused, and changed, for further watches.

5.3.0

    • stereotype

      DefinitionWatchRequest<T> stereotype(String annotationName)
      Selects only the definitions of beans carrying an annotation, directly or as a stereotype, named by its class name: a shorthand for qualifier(Qualifiers.byStereotype(annotationName)). A module matches an annotation of an optional dependency this way without referencing its class, which may not be on the classpath; when it is not, no definition carries the annotation and the request selects none.
      Parameters:
      annotationName - The fully qualified name of the annotation, such as io.micronaut.http.annotation.Controller
      Returns:
      This request

    • onAdded

      DefinitionWatchRequest<T> onAdded(Consumer<? super BeanDefinition<T>> handler)
      Adds a handler called with each definition added, once the batch that adds it is applied. For the first batch, it is called with every definition selected.
      Parameters:
      handler - The handler
      Returns:
      This request

    • onRemoved

      DefinitionWatchRequest<T> onRemoved(Consumer<? super BeanDefinition<T>> handler)
      Adds a handler called with each definition removed, once the batch that removes it is applied. A definition replaced by a new generation of itself is given to onReplaced(Consumer) instead, when there is such a handler.
      Parameters:
      handler - The handler
      Returns:
      This request

    • onReplaced

      DefinitionWatchRequest<T> onReplaced(Consumer<? super BeanDefinitionChange.Replacement<T>> handler)
      Adds a handler called with each definition removed and added again as a new generation of the same bean, as a development reload does when the bean's class changed. Without this handler, such a definition is given to onRemoved(Consumer) and its replacement to onAdded(Consumer).
      Parameters:
      handler - The handler
      Returns:
      This request
